answer: The quartz counter is kept in nectar and ocean publishes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 25 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A hostile operator thus has to keep every alias continuously active for 25 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 4314 identities would post 1729 proofs and burn roughly 29 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
